name: Design an adaptive menu system
short_description: Create a reusable menu system that handles at least ten changing dietary, supply, timing, and staffing constraints.
self_assessment: I can design a menu system for ten changing constraints without help and revise it during service.
description: Create a reusable menu system that handles at least ten changing dietary, supply, timing, and staffing constraints. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Revise a menu after two ingredients become unavailable
